contacts.title: Clients & contacts

contacts.noMatchCreate: No match — fill in the details below to add them.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.notConnected: Connect Google Calendar in Settings to push dates with reminders.
calendar.emptyHint: Add hearings, deadlines and appointments to see them here.

conflicts.title: Conflict check
conflicts.description: Check new clients and opposing parties against everyone we've ever worked with or against.
conflicts.instructions: Enter each person's name. Matching ignores accents and catches spelling variants (Merdado ↔ Mercado).
conflicts.found: {count, plural, =1 {1 possible match} other {# possible matches}} — review before accepting the matter
conflicts.footnote: A clear result means no similar names are in the CRM. It isn't a substitute for professional judgment.
conflicts.liveHint: Type the client's and other parties' names — matches will appear here.
conflicts.reviewHint: Review these before accepting the matter:

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your profile, the team, and connections.
settings.profileHint: Language and theme apply only to you.
settings.name: Name
settings.teamHint: Invite staff by the Google account email they'll sign in with.
settings.inviteHint: Invited people sign in with "Continue with Google" using that email. Nothing is emailed automatically — let them know.
settings.holidaysHint: Used by the UD deadline calculator. Seeded with California judicial holidays — verify each year against LASC's published court closure calendar.

google.accountHint: One firm account owns the Drive case folders and the Hearings and Deadlines calendar.

google.connectedToast: Google connected. Now choose the Cases folder and calendar.

google.folderSet: Case folders will be created in "{name}"

import.connectFirst: Connect Google in Settings → Google first.

sheet.title: Client Intake Form (Responses)
sheet.hint: Imports each row as a client + matter with the fee, payment and notes. Existing clients are matched by phone, email or name.
sheet.placeholder: Paste the Google Sheets link or ID

policy.age: No status → closed if over a year old

sheet.commitHint: Nothing is saved until you click Import. Re-running skips rows already imported.

drive.title: Existing case folders
drive.hint: Creates a matter for each folder in "{folder}" (or links it to an existing matter), and reads case numbers from each folder's 00 Intake doc when present.
drive.commitHint: Folders that don't follow "Last, First — Type (Side)" are skipped.

calendar.title: Existing hearings & deadlines
calendar.hint: Links upcoming events already on "{calendar}" to matters, without duplicating them.
calendar.commitHint: Linked events stay as they are in Google until edited in the CRM.
